workloads.description: customer workload (Astera Labs); compute derived from the customer's measured profile (example profile document), TP allreduce over a 4-tile mesh

NON-LLM workload: real radio-astronomy FX correlator (Murchison Widefield Array, the SKA-Low precursor and 256-input array). 16-tile sub-array cross-correlated over 8 nodes on a 3x3 mesh. Compute is DERIVED from the published MWA correlator specification (Ord et al. 2015, arXiv:1501.05992) by a formula stated in the profile's provenance block — 30.72 MHz in 24 coarse channels, 3072 fine channels, 0.5 s integration, 4-bit complex samples
